title: Judgment on the Philistines
description: The Lord's word comes to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh strikes Gaza. The Lord warns of an invasion from the north described as a flooding flood, with noise from horses and chariots that paralyzes the fathers. The judgment strikes the cities Gaza and Ashkelon and destroys the last remnant from the island of Caphtor, also as helpers for Tyre and Sidon. The prophecy ends with a cry to the Lord's sword to return to its sheath, but the sword cannot rest because the Lord himself has commanded it against Ashkelon and the seacoast. [ref:Jer 47:1-7|Jeremiah 47:1-7]
